violations.text: Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink at nursing station kitchenette. Electronic hand soap dispenser was non operational. Soap was removed from dispenser and must be manually poured to be used. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Hand sink maintenance was discussed with PIC. State handwashing guidance document sign provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

Food contact surfaces of the slicer were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

Milk in milk dispenser was observed held at 49 degrees Fahrenheit. Ambient of unit was observed at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Milk was assessed and voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Unit cannot be used until properly adjusted and can maintain an internal food temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

The doors to the outside (receiving door and door to outside in basement), are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/07/2026

A blade and cover for the food processor were observed in poor repair. The blade was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. PIC informed of cracked food processor cover. New Violation. Correct By: 12/07/2026
Caulking at mounting of kitchen handwashing sink was observed in poor repair (affecting cleanability). PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/07/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -gaskets and surrounding areas on 2 door reach-in in storage room -areas surroundings greasetrap -interior of nursing kitchenette refrigerator -funnel at food prep sink air gap -exterior of dishmachine -vent in dishroom New Violation. Correct By: 12/07/2026

The door to the outside, located in the basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2025
Gasket on 6 stack cooler was observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2025

Food contact surfaces of slicer was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2024

Insect carcasses (cockroaches) were observed on glue traps in dietary storage area. Deceased pests must be removed at a frequency to prevent attractants for other pests. PIC informed to remove. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2024

The cutting boards in the kitchen area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the refrigerator door gaskets, interior of the 2 door reach in, and fixture used to hang utensils have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Chest freezer was observed with ice accumulation. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2024
The following was observed in poor repair, -Coving under 3-bay sink -Caulking at kitchen hand sink Physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024
